calls.summary:
# Ali Rizvi and Ashley Stirrup
Date: 2026-10-02 | Duration: 33.130001068115234m

## Summary
The discussion focused on restructuring inadequate financial reporting and revenue recognition processes. Revenue and ARR are manually estimated from Stripe and HubSpot, with unclear deferred revenue, amortization, ownership, and methodology. Jeremy’s investor spreadsheet remains the main source for revenue and cash metrics but is not integrated with accounting systems. Accounts receivable reached $4.4 million, with a target of $2 million. Ali plans to review Fondo’s accounting practices, gain access to QuickBooks Online, Stripe, and HubSpot, and clarify cash balances, vendor management, and expense categorization. Mark’s financial model is outdated, hard-coded, missing accounts payable, and does not include next year’s hiring or budget; Ali plans to rebuild it for fiscal year 2027. Runway estimates range from the low 20s to about 25 months, with a goal of 24 months by January end supported by a $2 million Anthropic services deal, of which $500,000 has been collected. The company also needs formal monthly closes, bank reconciliations, cash collection targets, vendor classification, a COGS policy, clearer outsourcing accountability, and stricter adherence to approved hiring plans.

## Keywords
Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Cash Collections, Financial Modeling, Expense Classification, Outsourced Bookkeeping

## Action Items

**Ali Rizvi**
Send link to shared folder containing the latest spreadsheet from Mark (01:06)
Review Fondo’s accounting procedures through a direct call; identify responsibilities and gaps (14:03)
Obtain access to company’s QuickBooks Online and HubSpot instances to analyze financial data and revenue recognition processes (20:18)
Coordinate communication via Slack with Jennifer and request Slack invite to relevant channels (21:40)
Conduct a detailed line-by-line review of accounting entries with outsourced bookkeepers (14:03)
Meet with Mark for rebuilding the FY2028 financial model to align with hiring and financial planning (25:26)
Prepare comprehensive list of accounting and financial planning gaps for leadership review (24:30)
Establish a monthly close cadence and financial reporting framework with accounting team (23:58)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Coordinate with Jennifer to send Slack invite to Ali (21:11)
Share investor spreadsheet and company operational metrics with Ali for better transparency (04:44)
Assist in identifying and tagging all vendors and contractors for proper expense classification (15:05)
Facilitate contact between Ali and Fondo’s team, especially Nick, to clarify roles and responsibilities (20:44)
Communicate leadership’s headcount and hiring plan limits to team to improve budgeting discipline (27:16)
